method.scope: Complete transitive local module import closure, including the selected entry module. Each module counted once per closure. Mathlib and other external Lake dependencies excluded. Shared dependencies are counted in each separate theorem closure.
method.code_lines: Nonblank lines after masking Lean nested block comments and line comments; strings retained. Includes definitions, theorem statements, proofs, imports, and commands. This is source size, not minimal declaration-level proof size.
method.physical_lines: All text lines, including blank lines and comments; terminal line without newline also counted.
method.baseline_scope: The complete baseline source snapshot is compared with the working tree, counting all additions, deletions and moved code. Historical import closures are source measurements; the selected default baseline was independently accepted before cleanup.
